notes: v0.3.25 - fixes what the last update did on screen. Updating the companion app was throwing a black terminal onto your desktop and leaving it there; the flag meant to hide it was the reason it appeared. A stuck update no longer sits at 97% in silence - it counts the seconds, says when it is waiting, and after three minutes tells you it did not come back and how to fix it. And "shut down everything" no longer reports success when it could not reach Docker to check.
